column1: # Pre-registered manifest — orchestrate-loop generalization arm, third attempt
# on roadmap-user-story. Written BEFORE the first cell of this arm. Separate
# arm, separate results file; neither of the two earlier arms is amended or
# re-labeled.
# WHY A THIRD ARM, NOT A CONTINUATION OF EITHER EARLIER ONE.
# Arm 1 (experiment-manifest-orchestrate-userstory.tsv, seeds 201-204): 4/4
# lost to `runDirectiveOnce` never passing `sharedContext` (mission +
# tech-stack.md, which pins `fastapi[standard]`) into the prompt — the
# orchestrator built the entire app in Flask and failed the acceptance
# suite's `from app import app` at collection time. Fixed in
# `OrchestrateDirective.build` (gained an optional `projectContext`
# parameter); confirmed present on the wire, but not yet graded live at the
# time arm 2 was written.
# Arm 2 (experiment-manifest-orchestrate-userstory-fixed.tsv, seeds 211-220):
# 5/5 lost (seeds 211-215; 216-220 never ran) to a SECOND, independent bug —
# the engine's degeneracy guard aborted legitimate writes whose tail was a
# 64-dash comment separator, a false positive. Fixed as fork divergence #15;
# unit-verified across a 13-case table and both test tiers (785 tests), but
# — like the projectContext fix before it — never run against a live model
# before this arm.
# Seeds 211-220 are burnt (215 used, the arm abandoned once the cause was
# confirmed — the stop went in before any further cell's result was known,
# same instrument-integrity discipline as arm 1's stop). This arm uses
# 221-230: disjoint from 201-210 (arm 1, projectContext bug), 211-220 (arm 2,
# degeneracy-guard bug), 101-130 and 42 (roadmap-spec Block A), so no cell
# here was ever run under either broken prior state.
# PROVENANCE: repo HEAD 3dac58a (P26 gate cleared same day — see ROADMAP.md's
# P26 row) + both fixes above, already on main before this arm's first cell.
# ds4 pin unchanged from the two earlier arms (1a2dddf). TURN_TIMEOUT=1500,
# RUN_CAP=3600 — same as both earlier arms, so timeout policy is not a
# variable across any of the three.
# DESIGN: same task (roadmap-user-story), same n=10 as both earlier attempts,
# same decision rule, unpooled with either earlier arm (each measures a
# different harness state).
# CELL 1 IS A PLUMBING CHECK, NOT JUST A MEASUREMENT. Both fixes are live-
# unvalidated going into this arm. Inspect cell 1's outcome and capture by
# hand before letting cells 2-10 run unattended — if it fails on either
# earlier bug's signature (Flask in the app tree, or a degeneracy-guard abort
# on a legitimate write), stop immediately rather than burning the rest of
# the arm on a fix that didn't actually land.
# PRIMARY ENDPOINT: pass rate on roadmap-user-story under both fixes, Wilson
# 95% interval, read against Block A's roadmap-spec baseline 27/29=93% (still
# not pooled — different task, per the original design's reasoning carried
# forward from arm 2).
# DECISION RULE, unchanged from arms 1 and 2:
#  1. >=8/10 (80%): the loop generalizes across this task shift once given
#     the same project context the phase loop already gets and the
#     degeneracy-guard false positive is gone.
#  2. 5-7/10: a real signal that task framing matters beyond the two fixed
#     bugs; underpowered to size it further at this n.
#  3. <=4/10: reliability is task-specific even with both fixes; the 93%
#     figure keeps its "measured on one task" caveat, and failures feed the
#     Backlog "Orchestrate-loop generalization" entry directly.
# Additionally: if ANY cell in this arm still substitutes Flask, or aborts on
# a legitimate write via the degeneracy guard, that is reported explicitly
# and separately from the pass rate — it would mean a fix is necessary but
# not sufficient, a different finding than "the loop doesn't generalize."
# WHAT THIS CANNOT CONCLUDE: anything about tasks other than roadmap and
# roadmap-user-story; a precise rate at n=10; whether other gaps exist
# between directive mode and the phase loop besides the two fixed so far.
# Runner: TURN_TIMEOUT=1500 RUN_CAP=3600 \
#   CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST=<this> \
#   CAMPAIGN_RESULTS=docs/superpowers/research/experiment-results-orchestrate-userstory-221.tsv \
#   python3 Tools/run-orchestrate-campaign.py
